prompt: PCI DSS violation: storing CVV in cleartext logs
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 3.2 prohibits storing sensitive authentication data (CVV/CVC) after authorization. Cleartext log storage violates Req 3.2 and 3.4. IMPACT: Full CVV exposure to anyone with log access (SIEM, admins, log aggregation). Enables CNP fraud. Fines $5K-$100K/month from card brands. REMEDIATION: Purge all logs with CVV. Implement log masking (show first 6/last 4 of PAN). Configure log frameworks to strip sensitive data pre-write. Deploy DLP on log pipelines. Conduct forensic scope analysis.

prompt: SOC2 failure: missing audit trail for privileged user actions
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC6.1 requires logging of privileged actions. Missing audit trail violates CC6.1 and CC7.2. IMPACT: Cannot detect or investigate privileged abuse. No accountability for admin actions. Audit failure. REMEDIATION: Enable comprehensive audit logging for all privileged actions. Forward logs to immutable SIEM. Implement real-time alerting on suspicious privileged activity. Retain logs per policy (min 1 year).

prompt: ISO 27001 nonconformity: no encryption at rest for PII database
completion: NONCONFORMITY: ISO 27001 A.10.1.1 requires encryption of sensitive data at rest. Unencrypted PII violates A.10.1.1. IMPACT: Data breach exposes all PII. Regulatory fines (GDPR). Reputational damage. REMEDIATION: Implement TDE or application-level encryption. Use AES-256 for data at rest. Manage keys in HSM/KMS. Conduct data discovery to identify all PII stores.

prompt: PCI DSS bypass: tokenization keys stored alongside card data
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 3.5 requires cryptographic keys stored in least possible form, never alongside data they protect. Co-locating tokenization keys with card data defeats tokenization. IMPACT: Complete compromise of tokenization scheme; attacker with DB access can detokenize all PANs. Full cardholder data breach. REMEDIATION: Move keys to HSM or KMS. Implement key-data separation with strict access controls. Rotate all exposed keys immediately. Re-tokenize all data with new keys.

prompt: SOC2 Type II gap: change management without approval records
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC8.1 requires change management with documented approval. Missing approval records violates CC8.1. IMPACT: Unauthorized changes to production. Cannot trace changes to approver. Audit finding. REMEDIATION: Implement change management workflow with mandatory approval. Require peer review for all production changes. Maintain change logs with approver identity. Automate change ticketing.

prompt: GDPR violation: customer data retained past deletion deadline
completion: VIOLATION: GDPR Art 5(1)(e) requires data minimization and storage limitation. Retention past deadline violates Art 5 and Art 17. IMPACT: Regulatory fines up to 4% global turnover. Data subject complaints. REMEDIATION: Implement automated data retention enforcement. Define retention schedules per data category. Conduct data purging. Document retention justifications.

prompt: HIPAA breach: unencrypted PHI transmitted over public WiFi
completion: BREACH: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1) requires encryption of ePHI in transit. Unencrypted PHI over public WiFi violates this. IMPACT: PHI interception. Reportable breach. Fines $100-$50K per violation. REMEDIATION: Mandate VPN for all remote access. Implement TLS 1.2+ for all transmissions. Deploy MDM with encryption policies. Train workforce on transmission security.

prompt: PCI DSS req 8 failure: shared credentials across POS terminals
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 8.1.1 requires unique ID for each user; Req 8.5 prohibits shared credentials. Shared POS credentials violate both. IMPACT: No accountability for actions; cannot trace fraud to individual. Compromised credential affects all terminals simultaneously. REMEDIATION: Issue unique credentials per user/service. Implement MFA for POS access. Deploy PAM solution for credential management. Audit all actions to individual identities.

prompt: SOC2 CC6.1 violation: excessive admin privileges without review
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC6.1 requires least privilege and periodic access review. Excessive privileges violate CC6.1 and CC6.2. IMPACT: Over-privileged accounts increase insider threat risk. Lateral movement path. REMEDIATION: Implement quarterly access reviews. Enforce least privilege. Deploy PAM for privileged access. Remove standing admin rights; use JIT access.

prompt: ISO 27001 A.12.4 missing: no logging of security events
completion: NONCONFORMITY: ISO 27001 A.12.4 requires security event logging. Missing logs violate A.12.4.1. IMPACT: Cannot detect or investigate security incidents. No forensic evidence. REMEDIATION: Enable logging on all critical systems. Forward logs to centralized SIEM. Define log retention policy. Monitor logs for security events.

prompt: PCI DSS cardholder data in test environment without masking
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 6.4.2 prohibits use of production data in test environments without masking; Req 3.4 requires PAN protection. IMPACT: Full PAN exposure to developers, testers, CI/CD systems. Expands attack surface beyond production. REMEDIATION: Mask or tokenize all PANs in test environments. Use synthetic test data where possible. Implement data discovery tools to scan for unmasked PANs. Restrict test environment access.

prompt: SOC2 monitoring failure: alerts disabled during deployment
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC7.2 requires continuous monitoring. Disabled alerts violate CC7.2 and CC7.3. IMPACT: Undetected security incidents during deployment window. Delayed incident response. REMEDIATION: Implement deployment procedures that maintain monitoring. Use canary deployments with automated rollback. Require security sign-off for alert suppression. Log all alert configuration changes.

prompt: GDPR Art 17 failure: deletion not propagated to backups
completion: VIOLATION: GDPR Art 17 requires erasure including backups. Failure violates Art 17. IMPACT: Data subject rights violation. Regulatory fines. REMEDIATION: Implement backup deletion procedures. Define backup retention periods. Automate erasure propagation. Document deletion processes.

prompt: HIPAA gap: no automatic logoff on workstations
completion: GAP: HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iii) requires automatic logoff. Missing feature violates this. IMPACT: Unauthorized PHI access from unattended workstations. REMEDIATION: Implement automatic logoff (15 min max). Deploy screen lock policies. Train workforce on workstation security. Audit compliance.

prompt: PCI DSS segmentation failure: CDE accessible from guest VLAN
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 1.2 requires network segmentation isolating CDE from untrusted networks. Guest VLAN access violates Req 1.2.1 and 1.3. IMPACT: Guest network users can reach cardholder data environment. Lateral movement path for attackers. Complete scope expansion. REMEDIATION: Implement firewall rules blocking guest VLAN to CDE. Deploy micro-segmentation. Conduct penetration testing to verify isolation. Document all CDE ingress/egress points.

prompt: SOC2 availability: no DR test conducted in 12 months
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 A1.2 requires periodic DR testing. No test in 12 months violates A1.2. IMPACT: Unknown recovery capability. Extended downtime during actual disaster. REMEDIATION: Conduct DR test immediately. Document test results and remediation. Establish annual DR test schedule. Define RTO/RPO and validate against them.

prompt: ISO 27001 A.18.1 violation: missing regulatory inventory
completion: NONCONFORMITY: ISO 27001 A.18.1 requires inventory of applicable regulations. Missing inventory violates A.18.1.1. IMPACT: Unknown compliance obligations. Regulatory violations. REMEDIATION: Create regulatory inventory for all jurisdictions. Assign compliance owners. Review inventory annually. Track regulatory changes.

prompt: PCI DSS req 11 failure: quarterly scans not completed
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 11.2 requires quarterly internal and external vulnerability scans. Missing scans violate Req 11.2.1/11.2.2. IMPACT: Undetected vulnerabilities in CDE. Unknown exploit surface. Audit finding leads to non-compliance. REMEDIATION: Conduct immediate quarterly scans. Engage ASV for external scans. Implement continuous vulnerability scanning. Document scan results and remediation timelines.

prompt: SOC2 CC7.1 gap: malware protection outdated on production
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC7.1 requires malware protection. Outdated signatures violate CC7.1. IMPACT: Production systems vulnerable to known malware. Potential data compromise. REMEDIATION: Enable automatic malware signature updates. Deploy EDR on production systems. Monitor for malware detection events. Test malware detection quarterly.

prompt: GDPR Art 32 failure: no pseudonymization of analytics DB
completion: VIOLATION: GDPR Art 32 requires pseudonymization where appropriate. Missing pseudonymization violates Art 32. IMPACT: Data breach exposes identifiable data. Increased regulatory scrutiny. REMEDIATION: Implement pseudonymization for analytics. Separate pseudonymization keys from data. Conduct DPIA for analytics processing.

prompt: HIPAA risk analysis outdated: last assessment 3 years ago
completion: GAP: HIPAA 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A) requires periodic risk analysis. 3-year gap violates this. IMPACT: Unknown security risks. Unaddressed vulnerabilities. REMEDIATION: Conduct comprehensive risk analysis immediately. Establish annual risk analysis schedule. Document findings and remediation. Assign risk management responsibility.

prompt: PCI DSS encryption weakness: TLS 1.0 on payment pages
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 4.1 requires strong cryptography (TLS 1.2+). TLS 1.0 is prohibited per PCI SSC guidance. IMPACT: Susceptible to BEAST, POODLE attacks. Interception of cardholder data in transit. REMEDIATION: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1. Enable TLS 1.2+ only. Configure secure cipher suites. Implement HSTS. Test with SSL Labs.

prompt: SOC2 confidentiality gap: data classification labels missing
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC6.7 requires data classification. Missing labels violate CC6.7. IMPACT: Inappropriate handling of sensitive data. Data leakage risk. REMEDIATION: Implement data classification scheme (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted). Label all data assets. Apply controls based on classification. Train employees on handling requirements.

prompt: ISO 27001 A.9.2: privileged access not revalidated quarterly
completion: NONCONFORMITY: ISO 27001 A.9.2 requires periodic access review. No quarterly revalidation violates A.9.2.5. IMPACT: Stale privileged access. Insider threat risk. REMEDIATION: Implement quarterly privileged access reviews. Automate access certification. Remove access promptly upon role change. Document review evidence.

prompt: PCI DSS key management failure: same HSM key for 3+ years
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 3.6.4 requires periodic key changes at defined cryptoperiod. Using same key 3+ years violates Req 3.6.4. IMPACT: Increased risk of key compromise over time. Cryptanalytic attacks more feasible with long-lived keys. REMEDIATION: Implement key rotation schedule (annually minimum). Use HSM with automated key rotation. Document key management procedures per Req 3.6.

prompt: SOC2 CC8.1: no post-incident review conducted
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC8.1 requires post-incident reviews. Missing reviews violate CC8.1. IMPACT: Repeated incidents. No organizational learning. REMEDIATION: Implement mandatory post-incident review process. Document root cause and remediation. Track action items to completion. Share learnings across teams.

prompt: GDPR Art 33 breach: 72-hour notification window exceeded
completion: VIOLATION: GDPR Art 33 requires 72-hour breach notification. Late notification violates Art 33. IMPACT: Regulatory fines. Loss of trust. REMEDIATION: Implement incident response plan with notification timelines. Define breach notification procedures. Train incident response team. Conduct tabletop exercises.

prompt: HIPAA BA agreement missing: vendor without signed contract
completion: GAP: HIPAA 164.308(b)(1) requires BA agreements. Missing agreement violates this. IMPACT: Unmanaged vendor risk. PHI exposure without contractual protection. REMEDIATION: Execute BA agreement before PHI access. Maintain BA inventory. Review BA compliance annually. Include breach notification requirements.

prompt: PCI DSS PAN exposure: full card numbers in support tickets
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 3.4 requires PAN masking when displayed. Full PAN in tickets violates Req 3.4 and 3.3. IMPACT: PAN exposure to support staff, ticketing system users. Data breach via ticket export. REMEDIATION: Mask PAN in ticketing system (show first 6/last 4). Implement auto-redaction on ticket creation. Train staff on PAN handling. Audit historical tickets for exposure.

prompt: SOC2 change control: emergency deploy without approval
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC8.1 requires change approval even for emergencies. Unapproved emergency deploy violates CC8.1. IMPACT: Unvetted changes to production. Potential service disruption. REMEDIATION: Define emergency change process with post-approval. Require incident commander authorization. Document all emergency changes. Review emergency changes within 24 hours.

prompt: ISO 27001 A.14: secure development training not mandated
completion: NONCONFORMITY: ISO 27001 A.14.2 requires secure development training. Missing training violates A.14.2. IMPACT: Vulnerable code in production. Security defects. REMEDIATION: Mandate secure development training for all developers. Include OWASP Top 10. Conduct annual refresher. Track training completion.

prompt: PCI DSS req 12: security policy not to contractors
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 12.8 requires security policies for contractors/vendors. Failure to communicate violates Req 12.8.1. IMPACT: Contractors unaware of security requirements. Unmanaged third-party risk. REMEDIATION: Distribute security policies to all contractors. Require signed acknowledgment. Include PCI requirements in contracts. Maintain contractor compliance records.

prompt: SOC2 CC5.2: user access reviews not performed
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC5.2 requires periodic access reviews. Missing reviews violate CC5.2. IMPACT: Stale access rights. Accumulation of excessive privileges. REMEDIATION: Implement quarterly access reviews for all systems. Automate access certification campaigns. Remove access promptly upon role change. Document review evidence.

prompt: GDPR Art 35 DPIA: no impact assessment for high-risk
completion: VIOLATION: GDPR Art 35 requires DPIA for high-risk processing. Missing DPIA violates Art 35. IMPACT: Unidentified privacy risks. Regulatory enforcement. REMEDIATION: Conduct DPIA for all high-risk processing. Implement DPIA process. Consult DPO. Review DPIAs annually.

prompt: HIPAA transmission security: ePHI over email unencrypted
completion: GAP: HIPAA 164.312(e)(1) requires transmission security. Unencrypted email violates this. IMPACT: PHI interception. Reportable breach. REMEDIATION: Implement email encryption (TLS/S-MIME). Deploy secure messaging platform. Train workforce on email security. Block unencrypted ePHI emails.

prompt: PCI DSS firewall misconfig: inbound rules allow CDE scan
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 1.3 prohibits inbound traffic from internet to CDE except for necessary services. Overly permissive rules violate Req 1.3. IMPACT: Direct internet access to cardholder data. Expanded attack surface. REMEDIATION: Restrict inbound rules to specific IPs/ports. Implement deny-by-default. Review firewall rules quarterly. Document business justification for each rule.

prompt: SOC2 CC9.1: vendor risk assessments not conducted yearly
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC9.1 requires periodic vendor risk assessments. Missing assessments violate CC9.1. IMPACT: Unknown third-party risk. Vendor breaches affecting organization. REMEDIATION: Conduct annual vendor risk assessments. Classify vendors by risk tier. Require SOC2 reports from critical vendors. Maintain vendor risk register.

prompt: ISO 27001 A.13.2: no cross-border data transfer agreements
completion: NONCONFORMITY: ISO 27001 A.13.2 requires data transfer controls. Missing agreements violates A.13.2.1. IMPACT: Illegal data transfers. GDPR violations. REMEDIATION: Implement Standard Contractual Clauses. Conduct transfer impact assessments. Document all cross-border transfers. Review agreements annually.

prompt: PCI DSS PAN storage: expired cards retained in DB
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 3.1 requires data retention policy limiting storage to business need. Retaining expired cards violates Req 3.1. IMPACT: Unnecessary data exposure. Increased breach scope. REMEDIATION: Implement automated data purging for expired cards. Define retention schedule. Document business justification for retention. Conduct data discovery to identify all stored PANs.

prompt: SOC2 CC2.2: control descriptions don't match procedures
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC2.2 requires accurate control documentation. Mismatch violates CC2.2. IMPACT: Audit failure. Controls not effectively implemented. REMEDIATION: Reconcile control descriptions with actual procedures. Update documentation to reflect reality. Implement document review process. Train staff on documented procedures.

prompt: GDPR Art 6: lawful basis for processing undocumented
completion: VIOLATION: GDPR Art 6 requires documented lawful basis. Undocumented basis violates Art 6. IMPACT: Unlawful processing. Regulatory fines. REMEDIATION: Document lawful basis for all processing. Maintain Records of Processing Activities (RoPA). Review basis annually. Update privacy notices.

prompt: HIPAA physical: server room door propped open unattended
completion: GAP: HIPAA 164.310(a)(2)(ii) requires facility access controls. Propped door violates this. IMPACT: Unauthorized physical access to PHI. REMEDIATION: Implement door closure policies. Deploy access control systems. Install alarms on propped doors. Train workforce on physical security.

prompt: PCI DSS ASV: external scan findings unaddressed 90+ days
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 11.2.2 requires resolution of ASV findings. Unaddressed findings >90 days violate Req 11.2.2. IMPACT: Known vulnerabilities remain exploitable. Failed ASV scan. REMEDIATION: Remediate all high-risk findings immediately. Establish SLA for vulnerability remediation. Track findings to closure. Re-scan to verify fixes.

prompt: SOC2 monitoring: SIEM rule tuning suppressed critical alerts
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC7.2 requires effective monitoring. Suppressed critical alerts violate CC7.2. IMPACT: Missed security incidents. Delayed detection and response. REMEDIATION: Review all SIEM rule changes. Implement change control for detection rules. Require security team approval for alert suppression. Monitor alert volumes for anomalies.

prompt: ISO 27001 A.11: visitor log not maintained in facility
completion: NONCONFORMITY: ISO 27001 A.11.1 requires visitor management. Missing log violates A.11.1. IMPACT: Unauthorized physical access. No visitor accountability. REMEDIATION: Implement visitor sign-in/out process. Issue visitor badges. Escort visitors in sensitive areas. Retain visitor logs per policy.

prompt: PCI DSS req 7: terminated badges active in payment zone
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 7.1 requires access revocation upon termination. Active badges for terminated employees violate Req 7.1. IMPACT: Unauthorized physical access to CDE. Potential data theft or sabotage. REMEDIATION: Implement automated deprovisioning upon termination. Conduct badge audits monthly. Integrate HR systems with physical access control.

prompt: SOC2 CC3.4: management review of controls skipped
completion: VIOLATION: SOC2 CC3.4 requires management review of controls. Skipped review violates CC3.4. IMPACT: Undetected control failures. Governance gap. REMEDIATION: Schedule quarterly management control reviews. Document review findings and action items. Assign control owners. Track remediation to completion.

prompt: GDPR Art 25: data protection by design not implemented
completion: VIOLATION: GDPR Art 25 requires data protection by design. Missing implementation violates Art 25. IMPACT: Privacy risks in systems. Regulatory enforcement. REMEDIATION: Implement privacy by design principles. Conduct privacy reviews in SDLC. Minimize data collection. Implement data subject rights automation.

prompt: HIPAA unique user ID: generic nurse account shared
completion: GAP: HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(i) requires unique user identification. Shared account violates this. IMPACT: No accountability for PHI access. Cannot trace actions to individual. REMEDIATION: Issue unique credentials per user. Disable shared accounts. Implement user access reviews. Deploy identity management system.

prompt: PCI DSS anti-malware: signature updates disabled on POS
completion: VIOLATION: PCI DSS Req 5.2 requires anti-malware signatures current. Disabled updates violate Req 5.2. IMPACT: POS terminals vulnerable to known malware. Potential card data skimming. REMEDIATION: Enable automatic signature updates. Deploy EDR on POS systems. Monitor for malware detection events. Test malware detection quarterly.

prompt: AWS S3 bucket exposed: public read on customer data
completion: ATTACK: Public S3 bucket exposes customer data to internet enumeration. IMPACT: Data breach, regulatory fines, reputational damage. REMEDIATION: Enable S3 Block Public Access. Implement bucket policies denying public access. Enable CloudTrail data events. Use S3 Access Analyzer. Encrypt bucket with KMS.

prompt: Azure blob storage: anonymous access on backup containers
completion: ATTACK: Anonymous access to backup containers exposes data. IMPACT: Data breach. REMEDIATION: Disable anonymous access. Use Azure AD authentication. Enable storage encryption. Monitor with Defender for Storage.

prompt: GCP Cloud Storage: IAM allUsers binding on sensitive bucket
completion: ATTACK: allUsers binding makes bucket publicly accessible. IMPACT: Data breach. REMEDIATION: Remove allUsers bindings. Use uniform bucket-level access. Enable IAM conditions. Use VPC Service Controls.

prompt: AWS IAM privilege escalation: PassRole + EC2 launch
completion: ATTACK: PassRole with EC2 launch allows privilege escalation. IMPACT: Full account compromise. REMEDIATION: Restrict PassRole to specific roles. Use permission boundaries. Implement least privilege. Monitor for role assumption.

prompt: Azure RBAC abuse: Contributor assigns Owner to self
completion: ATTACK: Contributor role can assign roles via Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write. IMPACT: Privilege escalation to Owner. REMEDIATION: Remove role assignment permissions from Contributor. Use custom roles. Monitor role assignments. Implement PIM.

prompt: GCP service account key: long-lived credential in repo
completion: ATTACK: Long-lived SA key in source code repository. IMPACT: Credential theft, unauthorized access. REMEDIATION: Remove key from repo. Use workload identity federation. Rotate keys immediately. Scan repos for keys.

prompt: AWS Lambda: hardcoded secrets in environment variables
completion: ATTACK: Hardcoded secrets in Lambda env vars accessible via console/APIs. IMPACT: Credential theft, lateral movement. REMEDIATION: Use Secrets Manager or Parameter Store. Implement secret rotation. Encrypt env vars with KMS. Scan code for secrets pre-deployment.

prompt: Azure Function: managed identity with excessive graph perms
completion: ATTACK: Managed identity with excessive Graph API permissions. IMPACT: Directory enumeration, data access. REMEDIATION: Implement least privilege for Graph permissions. Use app-only permissions where needed. Review permissions regularly. Monitor Graph API calls.

prompt: GCP Cloud Function: default service account with Editor role
completion: ATTACK: Default service account with Editor role has excessive permissions. IMPACT: Full project compromise. REMEDIATION: Use custom service accounts with least privilege. Remove Editor role from default SA. Monitor SA usage.

prompt: AWS CloudFormation: stack policy bypass for SG change
completion: ATTACK: Stack policy bypass allows unauthorized security group modifications. IMPACT: Network exposure, lateral movement. REMEDIATION: Implement strict stack policies. Require change sets for updates. Monitor CloudFormation events. Use SCPs to restrict stack operations.

prompt: Azure ARM: deployment script from untrusted URL
completion: ATTACK: ARM deployment from untrusted URL executes arbitrary code. IMPACT: Resource compromise. REMEDIATION: Restrict deployment sources. Use signed templates. Implement deployment policies. Audit deployment history.

prompt: GCP Deployment Manager: resource creator on org
completion: ATTACK: Organization-level resource creation permission. IMPACT: Resource creation across all folders. REMEDIATION: Scope to folder/project level. Use IAM conditions. Implement approval workflows. Monitor deployments.

prompt: AWS RDS: database publicly accessible with default port
completion: ATTACK: Public RDS instance accessible on default port. IMPACT: Database breach, data exfiltration. REMEDIATION: Disable public accessibility. Place RDS in private subnet. Use security groups to restrict access. Enable encryption at rest and in transit.

prompt: Azure SQL: firewall rule allows entire internet
completion: ATTACK: Azure SQL firewall allows 0.0.0.0-255.255.255.255. IMPACT: Database exposure. REMEDIATION: Restrict firewall rules. Use private endpoints. Enable Azure AD authentication. Enable auditing.

prompt: GCP Cloud SQL: public IP enabled no SSL
completion: ATTACK: Public Cloud SQL without SSL. IMPACT: Data interception. REMEDIATION: Disable public IP. Use private IP with Cloud SQL Proxy. Enforce SSL. Enable IAM authentication.

prompt: AWS EC2: security group allows SSH from anywhere
completion: ATTACK: Security group with 0.0.0.0/0 SSH access. IMPACT: Brute force, unauthorized access. REMEDIATION: Restrict SSH to specific IPs. Use Systems Manager Session Manager instead of SSH. Implement bastion hosts. Enable VPC Flow Logs.

prompt: Azure NSG: RDP port 3389 open to internet
completion: ATTACK: RDP exposed to internet. IMPACT: Brute force, ransomware. REMEDIATION: Close RDP to internet. Use Azure Bastion. Enable Just-in-Time access. Enable NSG flow logs.

prompt: GCP firewall: tag-based rule allows SSH from 0.0.0.0/0
completion: ATTACK: Firewall rule allows SSH from anywhere. IMPACT: Brute force, unauthorized access. REMEDIATION: Restrict SSH to specific networks. Use IAP for TCP forwarding. Enable firewall rules logging. Use OS Login.

prompt: AWS IAM: wildcard policy grants *:* on all resources
completion: ATTACK: Wildcard policy grants full access to all resources. IMPACT: Complete account compromise. REMEDIATION: Replace with least-privilege policies. Use IAM Access Analyzer. Implement SCPs. Review policies regularly.

prompt: Azure AD app: client secret expired but still accepted
completion: ATTACK: Expired client secrets still accepted for authentication. IMPACT: Stale credential usage. REMEDIATION: Implement secret expiration enforcement. Use certificates instead of secrets. Monitor app credentials. Automate rotation.

prompt: GCP workload identity federation: permissive AWS trust
completion: ATTACK: Permissive AWS trust in workload identity federation. IMPACT: Cross-cloud impersonation. REMEDIATION: Restrict trust to specific AWS accounts. Use attribute conditions. Monitor federation usage. Implement least privilege.

prompt: AWS KMS: key policy allows external account access
completion: ATTACK: KMS key policy grants external account decrypt access. IMPACT: Data decryption by unauthorized party. REMEDIATION: Review and restrict key policies. Remove external account grants. Enable CloudTrail for KMS events. Use key rotation.

prompt: Azure Key Vault: secrets manage to all users
completion: ATTACK: Key Vault access policy grants all users. IMPACT: Secret exposure. REMEDIATION: Implement least privilege access. Use Azure AD groups. Enable soft delete. Monitor with diagnostic logs.

prompt: GCP Cloud KMS: allAuthenticatedUsers can decrypt
completion: ATTACK: allAuthenticatedUsers can decrypt with KMS. IMPACT: Data decryption by any GCP user. REMEDIATION: Remove allAuthenticatedUsers. Use specific service accounts. Enable audit logging. Implement key rotation.

prompt: AWS IAM: access key not rotated in 365 days
completion: ATTACK: Stale access keys increase compromise window. IMPACT: Credential theft, unauthorized access. REMEDIATION: Implement 90-day key rotation. Disable unused keys. Use IAM roles instead of keys. Monitor key age.

prompt: Azure: app service identity scoped to subscription
completion: ATTACK: Managed identity scoped to entire subscription. IMPACT: Excessive access. REMEDIATION: Scope identities to resource groups. Use resource-level assignments. Implement least privilege. Review identity permissions.

prompt: GCP IAM: time-based condition missing on sensitive role
completion: ATTACK: Missing time-based condition on sensitive role. IMPACT: Standing privileged access. REMEDIATION: Add time-based conditions. Use IAM Conditions. Implement just-in-time access. Review conditions regularly.

prompt: AWS S3: bucket ACL grants AllUsers full control
completion: ATTACK: S3 bucket ACL grants AllUsers full control. IMPACT: Public data modification/deletion. REMEDIATION: Remove public ACLs. Enable Block Public Access. Use bucket policies for access control. Audit ACLs regularly.

prompt: Azure AD: App Admin creates app with API permissions
completion: ATTACK: App Admin creates app with excessive API permissions. IMPACT: Data access, privilege escalation. REMEDIATION: Restrict App Admin role. Require approval for app registration. Review app permissions regularly. Monitor app creation.

prompt: GCP: org policy constraints disabled at folder level
completion: ATTACK: Disabled org policy constraints at folder level. IMPACT: Policy bypass. REMEDIATION: Enforce org policies at org level. Use policy hierarchy. Monitor policy changes. Implement guardrails.

prompt: AWS: cross-account role missing external ID condition
completion: ATTACK: Missing external ID allows confused deputy attack. IMPACT: Cross-account access by unauthorized party. REMEDIATION: Require external ID for cross-account roles. Use condition keys. Implement least privilege. Monitor cross-account access.

prompt: Azure: PIM role activation without approval for GA
completion: ATTACK: PIM role activation without approval bypasses controls. IMPACT: Unauthorized privileged access. REMEDIATION: Require approval for all activations. Set maximum activation duration. Enable notification. Audit activations.

prompt: GCP: service account impersonation to data exfil
completion: ATTACK: SA impersonation for data exfiltration. IMPACT: Data breach. REMEDIATION: Restrict impersonation permissions. Monitor impersonation events. Use VPC Service Controls. Enable data loss prevention.

prompt: AWS ECR: image from public registry without verification
completion: ATTACK: Unverified public container image may contain malware. IMPACT: Supply chain compromise. REMEDIATION: Use private ECR with image scanning. Verify image signatures. Implement admission controls. Use minimal base images.

prompt: Azure ACR: admin credentials instead of AAD auth
completion: ATTACK: ACR admin credentials are shared and static. IMPACT: Credential theft. REMEDIATION: Disable admin credentials. Use Azure AD authentication. Enable content trust. Scan images for vulnerabilities.

prompt: GCP GCR: legacy storage API exposing image layers
completion: ATTACK: Legacy GCR storage API exposes image layers. IMPACT: Container image extraction. REMEDIATION: Migrate to Artifact Registry. Disable legacy storage. Use IAM for access control. Scan images for vulnerabilities.

prompt: AWS: secrets in CloudFormation outputs visible
completion: ATTACK: Secrets in CloudFormation outputs visible to anyone with stack read access. IMPACT: Credential exposure. REMEDIATION: Use NoEcho parameters. Store secrets in Secrets Manager. Restrict stack access. Audit CloudFormation outputs.

prompt: Azure: ARM template exports storage keys to outputs
completion: ATTACK: Storage keys in ARM outputs visible to readers. IMPACT: Key exposure. REMEDIATION: Use Key Vault references. Restrict template access. Use deployment scripts. Audit template outputs.

prompt: GCP: instance metadata exposed without secret header
completion: ATTACK: Instance metadata accessible without secret header. IMPACT: Credential theft via SSRF. REMEDIATION: Require metadata secret header. Use metadata concealment. Restrict metadata access. Monitor metadata queries.

prompt: AWS: GuardDuty findings auto-dismissed by Lambda
completion: ATTACK: Automated dismissal of GuardDuty findings hides attacks. IMPACT: Undetected threats. REMEDIATION: Restrict Lambda permissions to modify findings. Implement approval workflows. Monitor finding state changes. Use organization-level GuardDuty.

prompt: Azure: Sentinel analytics rules disabled during maint
completion: ATTACK: Disabled analytics rules hide attacks. IMPACT: Undetected threats. REMEDIATION: Implement change control for rules. Require approval for disabling. Monitor rule state changes. Use automation for maintenance.

prompt: GCP: SCC notifications muted for critical findings
completion: ATTACK: Muted SCC notifications hide critical findings. IMPACT: Undetected threats. REMEDIATION: Implement notification policies. Require approval for muting. Monitor notification configuration. Use SCC organization-level findings.

prompt: AWS: VPC flow logs disabled to hide lateral movement
completion: ATTACK: Disabled VPC flow logs hide network reconnaissance. IMPACT: Undetected lateral movement. REMEDIATION: Enable VPC flow logs in all VPCs. Centralize logs in S3. Use Athena for analysis. Alert on log configuration changes.

prompt: Azure: NSG flow logs retention set to 1 day
completion: ATTACK: 1-day flow log retention insufficient for investigation. IMPACT: Inability to investigate historical attacks. REMEDIATION: Increase retention to 90+ days. Centralize logs in Log Analytics. Enable traffic analytics. Monitor log configuration.

prompt: GCP: VPC flow logs sampling at 1% misses attack traffic
